name: English
title: Right Click MP3 — convert MP4 to MP3 from the Windows right-click menu
ogTitle: Right Click MP3 — convert MP4 to MP3 with one right-click
description: Free open-source Windows tool. Right-click any video or music file, pick MP3, done. Converts many files at once. No ads, no uploads, no account, no adware.
h1: Turn a video into an MP3 with one right-click.
lede: For the old MP3 player that only plays MP3. Select your files in Windows Explorer, right-click, pick a format. That is the whole program.
ctaNote: Free · open source · no ads · no account · nothing is uploaded anywhere
menuAria: Example of the Windows right-click menu
install2: Run it. No administrator password: it installs into your own user folder.
install3: Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box, because the installer is not code-signed yet. Click More info → Run anyway.
install4: Done. The menu works right away — no reboot, no sign-out.
installScript: Prefer scripts? Download the source zip and run:
use1: Select one file or fifty in File Explorer.
use2: Right-click → Convert To → choose a format. On Windows 11 it lives under Show more options.
use3: A small progress window runs, with a Cancel button. The new files appear in the same folder, next to the originals. Nothing is replaced or deleted.
useNote: The first conversion asks permission to download ffmpeg (about 30 MB), the free engine that does the actual work. After that it starts instantly.
uninstall1: Settings → Apps → Installed apps → Right Click MP3 → Uninstall.
uninstall3: Either one removes the menu, the shortcut, the program folder and its copy of ffmpeg. Your converted files stay where they are.
whyTitle: Why this instead of a converter website
why1: Your files stay on your computer. No upload, no queue, no size limit.
why2: No adware. The installer contains this program and nothing else. Every line is public on GitHub.
why3: No admin password and no account to create.
why4: Whole albums at once instead of one file per page reload.
formatsTo: Converts to: MP3 (192 or 320 kbps), AAC/M4A, WAV, FLAC.
formatsFrom: Reads: MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WEBM, WMV, M4A, AAC, OGG, OPUS, WMA, WAV, FLAC, MP3.
a1: Yes. MIT licensed, no paid tier, no upsell, no nag screen.
q2: Why does Windows warn about it?
a2: Code-signing certificates cost money, so SmartScreen does not recognise the publisher yet. You can read every line of the source, or build the installer yourself, before trusting it.
a3: The free conversion engine most media software is built on. It is downloaded from the official Windows build server into your user folder.
q4: Does it work on a Mac?
a4: No — this is a Windows Explorer feature. Windows 10 and 11.
q5: Does it delete or change my originals?
a5: Never. The converted file is written next to the original, and if that name is taken it becomes song (1).mp3.
